subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should the WhatsApp phone-code work be required to prove restart-free 515 finalization before this issue closes, or should this remain a separate WhatsApp recovery bug after the phone-code entrypoint lands?
rationale: Current main is QR-only, the open phone-code PRs overlap this report without merging, and the remaining behavior crosses public CLI/plugin auth API shape plus persisted WhatsApp session-state readiness.

options.title: Require Restart-Free Proof In Phone-Code PR
options.body: Keep this issue open until the active phone-code PR or replacement branch shows live WhatsApp pairing completing without a manual gateway restart.

options.title: Split A Narrow Recovery Bug
options.body: Land phone-code login separately and keep this issue as a WhatsApp-owned 515 recovery task with live proof expectations.

options.title: Document The Restart Workaround
options.body: Treat manual gateway restart during 515 as accepted operator behavior, but only after maintainers explicitly decide that no product recovery path is needed.

recommendation.title: Require Restart-Free Proof In Phone-Code PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the active phone-code PR or replacement branch shows live WhatsApp pairing completing without a manual gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans public CLI, plugin auth API, docs, and WhatsApp channel recovery boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the best routing owner.
